text:
Sara P.: Hey team — prepping the Coop Launch QBR (next Wed). We need the final list of eligible SIs + HW partners for co-marketing grants (MDF) and the scoring rubric for the QBR scorecards. @Mike F. can finance confirm the available pool and cadence? cc @Ana M. @Devin K. :eyes:

Mike F.: Finance: current MDF pool for the pilot is $120k. Rough split proposal: $40k marketplace co-markets, $50k SI enablement, $30k HW rebates. We need explicit eligibility gates before we allocate.

Ana M.: Marketplace note — partners must be live on marketplace listing by the commit date to qualify for marketplace co-marketing. We also need an asset checklist (logo, 1-pager, listing tile, 1 integration screenshot). If listing date slips, they drop to Silver tier.

Devin K.: SI onboarding update — Symph: infra tests passed, ETA to marketplace listing next Tue. Orbit: integration tests failing on billing hook; engineering says +3 weeks. Proposed gating: tech integration complete + 1 joint customer reference (or equivalent reference call).

Li (GTM Ops): Scoring proposal (suggested weights): Revenue potential 40%, Product fit (listing + depth) 30%, Strategic value (co-announce potential) 20%, Enablement readiness 10%. Also propose tier bands: Gold / Silver / Bronze with different MDF bands.

Sara P.: That weighting looks reasonable. Can someone paste a sample scorecard template we can surface in the QBR deck? Also want to know if we can pull partner scoring fields automatically from SFDC / Looker to avoid manual edits.

Mike F.: Sample budget calc I used: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/abc123 (view only). Example formula for MDF by tier: `=IF(Tier="Gold",25000,IF(Tier="Silver",10000,5000))`. Note: final approvals still need finance lead sign-off.

Devin K.: Technical gating checklist (short):
```
- API auth tested (oauth or api-key)
- Marketplace billing integration verified
- End-to-end deploy of sample app
- 1 perf run <200ms p95 on benchmark harness
```
Orbit is missing billing verification right now.

Ollie (Legal): Legal checklist: signed partner agreement, logo usage form, and joint announcement sign-off. For co-announces we need 2 rounds of copy review. Reference co-branding guide v2: /legal/co-branding-v2.pdf.

Sara P.: Action items: (1) @Mike F. confirm MDF split + timeline by EOD Thurs, (2) @Ana M. + @Devin K. update the partner sheet with final listing dates and gating flags, (3) @Li draft QBR slides with scorecards and tier mapping, (4) @Ollie prep the legal bundle for sign-off. I'll run a dry-run Monday 10am. :calendar:

Li (GTM Ops): Will draft slides and share a preview link by Friday.

Ana M.: Added rows for Symph and Orbit in the sheet and flagged Orbit as "billing pending" — @Devin K. can you verify the billing hook status? Also pinged the marketplace ops team for listing ETA.

Mike F.: Confirming MDF pool but queued for final approval from finance lead. Marked tentative allocations in the sheet. :white_check_mark:

qbr-bot: New QBR event scheduled: "Coop Launch — Partner Ops Readout" — Wed 11:00 AM — Calendar invite sent to attendees.

Sara P.: Thanks everyone — I'll consolidate the inputs into the QBR repo and drop a link here once slides are ready.
